description: A single table rendered as an image, captioned "Table 1 GMM-augmented datase" (caption truncated in the supplied text). The table has six columns headed, left to right: "Sort" (a running row index), "σ0/MPa", "σg/MPa", "σd/MPa", "σOrowan/MPa" and "YS /MPa" — i.e. a base/friction-stress-like term, three strengthening-mechanism contributions, and the resulting yield strength, all in megapascals. Six fully printed rows (Sort 1-6) are followed by a row of dots ("......") marking omitted entries, and then four fully printed rows (Sort 773, 774, 775, 776) immediately before the table ends, i.e. only 10 of the 776 dataset rows are shown. Row 1 gives σ0 = 80, σg = 528, σd = 321, σOrowan = 178, YS = 1000 MPa; row 3 gives the lowest shown values (20, 93, 0, 0, YS = 118); row 774 gives the highest shown YS = 1078.45 MPa with σ0 = 248.51, σg = 379.68, σd = 146.14, σOrowan = 159.68. Several rows have exactly 0 for σd and/or σOrowan. The table's role is to display a fragment of the Gaussian-mixture-model-augmented dataset used to train the yield-strength prediction model; it shows no material, processing or condition labels, and no numerical values beyond the tabulated cells are printed.

observations.observation: The table is headed with six columns: Sort, σ0/MPa, σg/MPa, σd/MPa, σOrowan/MPa, YS /MPa.
Only ten data rows are printed in full: Sort 1-6 and Sort 773-776, with a row of dots ("......") indicating the omitted intermediate entries.
Row Sort 1 lists σ0 = 80 MPa, σg = 528 MPa, σd = 321 MPa, σOrowan = 178 MPa and YS = 1000 MPa.
Row Sort 3 has the smallest printed values, with σ0 = 20 MPa, σg = 93 MPa, σd = 0, σOrowan = 0 and YS = 118 MPa.
Row Sort 774 has the largest printed YS, 1078.45 MPa, with σ0 = 248.51 MPa, σg = 379.68 MPa, σd = 146.14 MPa and σOrowan = 159.68 MPa.
Rows Sort 3, 5, 6, 773 and 775 print σOrowan = 0 MPa, and rows Sort 3 and 773 print σd = 0 MPa.
Every reported quantity in the table is in MPa; no non-zero value exceeds four printed digits (maximum YS = 1078.45 MPa).
The table carries no alloy name, composition, processing condition or reference label — the only identifier per row is the integer 'Sort' index.
The caption states the table is the 'GMM-augmented datase[t]', i.e. rows produced by Gaussian mixture model augmentation rather than original experimental records.
The citing text states that a stratified sampling strategy generated 599 synthetic samples, increasing the augmented dataset to 776, and that part of this augmented data is shown in Table 1.

The citing text describes the augmentation pipeline as standardization, BIC-based selection of the number of mixture components, EM estimation of means/covariances/weights, then stratified sampling — the table itself does not display any of these steps.

The table presents four strengthening-mechanism contributions (σ0, σg, σd, σOrowan) plus the resulting YS for each sample, i.e. it encodes the multi-mechanism superposition that the prediction model is trained on.

subfigures.description: A six-column numeric table with columns Sort, σ0/MPa, σg/MPa, σd/MPa, σOrowan/MPa, YS /MPa. Rows 1-6 are printed, then an ellipsis row "......", then rows 773-776; values range from YS 118 MPa (row 3) to 1078.45 MPa (row 774).
